bio.text: John Cowan, a neurosurgeon from Northwest Georgia, is the Republican nominee for Georgia's 11th Congressional District in the November 2026 general election.
He won the June 16, 2026 Republican runoff for the seat being vacated by Rep. Barry Loudermilk.
He previously ran unsuccessfully in the 2020 Republican primary for Georgia's 14th Congressional District.

sources.title: Cowan wins Republican primary for Barry Loudermilk's US House seat in Georgia
